resolved_lessons.avoid: Never quote gross accuracy or gross return as tradable; costs are part of the result.
resolved_lessons.remedy: Trade only when the causal expected move is at least 2x the round-trip cost, then re-test.

goal_80.reason: A single self-correction run can never establish the project target: that needs 1000+ real hidden-future attempts per candidate, positive net after 10 bps, a Wilson lower bound at the target and fresh validation on unseen symbols and days.

honesty: Signals use completed bars only; the forward return is read after the call is fixed.
Every metric is reported with its attempt count and coverage.
Costs are subtracted from every attempt; gross and net are both shown.
A retired candidate is excluded with its reason, not quietly dropped.
Regime labels are causal (trailing data), so no regime is chosen after the result.
The 80% target is a goal; this run never claims it is reached.
next_actions: Supply a longer history so each candidate can reach at least 300 separated attempts.
Keep the cost-aware filter on: only trade when the causal expected move pays for costs.
16 candidate(s) are retired and remembered; later runs skip them automatically.
Zoom out: more symbols, more days and an untouched final holdout are the only real promotion test.
